quotations.old_english: Hié ðone lifgendan God and ðone hálgan heáhengel Michael meagollíce (cf. Homl. Th. i. 504, 7 where in the same narrative geomlíce bǽdon occurs) gebǽdon
quotations.english: they earnestly prayed to the living God and the holy archangel Michael

quotations.old_english: Hé hafaþ wíslícu word, wile meagollíce módum tǽcan

source_text: meagol-líce; adv. Earnestly, strenuously :-- Hié ðone lifgendan God and ðone hálgan heáhengel Michael meagollíce (cf. Homl. Th. i. 504, 7 where in the same narrative geomlíce bǽdon occurs) gebǽdon they earnestly prayed to the living God and the holy archangel Michael, Blickl. Homl. 201, 13. Hé hafaþ wíslícu word, wile meagollíce módum tǽcan, Cd. 169; Th. 211, 16; Exod. 527.
